Title: Content Description
Content:
<color=#1272bb>[Content Unlock]</color>
Complete the Pilotage missions [Leisure Time Invitation] and [Toward Undiscovered Beauty] to unlock abundant game content.

<color=#1272bb>[View Info]</color>
After completing the Pilotage mission [Toward Undiscovered Beauty], you can view specific unlock conditions for each gameplay mode through [Operation Guide II] → [Guide] → [Mode Guide].

Title: Content Description
Content:
Commandants can use the <color=#1272bb>Early Access</color> feature to bypass the prerequisite mission [Toward Undiscovered Beauty] and directly access the mission [Homecoming and A New Journey]. (The Early Access feature will be unlocked after completing the [Leisure Time Invitation] mission.)

Using the Early Access feature <color=#1272bb>will not affect</color> the completion status of the prerequisite mission.
The Early Access status will disappear once the prerequisite mission is completed.

Title: Content Description
Content: Each area can have <color=#1272bb>one</color> duty schedule.\n\nOnce set, the assigned character will appear in that area.
